name: LobeChat
tagline: Modern open-source AI chat and agent workspace supporting local LLMs, knowledge bases, and plugin tools.
real_test_summary: Tested self-hosting LobeChat connected to a local Ollama endpoint with custom assistants and local file knowledge. Offers a polished interface for daily local chat.
pros: Modern UI with custom assistant presets, artifacts, and knowledge files
Connects directly to local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible servers
MIT open-source license with flexible self-hosting options
cons: Self-hosting full features involves extra environment configuration
Heavier web UI footprint than minimal terminal clients
